BiblicalUsage: Shacharajim was a Benjamite who fathered children in the country of Moab, after he had sent away Hushim and Baara. His name appears once, in the genealogy of Benjamin, where his household is counted among the tribe.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God keeps the names of quiet men in His book, even when their story is only a single verse.
